name: zgml
description: A tiny TS-first ML library with a PyTorch-like frontend over inspectable native executable programs.

scripts.dev:zig:metal-row-chain: zig build test -Duse-metal=true -fincremental --summary failures -- --test-filter "metal backend exact command fuses qmatmul residual into row chain"
scripts.dev:zig:metal-row-chain:watch: zig build test -Duse-metal=true -fincremental --watch --debounce 150 --summary line --error-style minimal_clear -- --test-filter "metal backend exact command fuses qmatmul residual into row chain"
scripts.dev:perf:module-program: zig build ffi-c -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -fincremental --summary failures && npm run build:package && BENCH_MODULE_PROGRAM_KEYS=${BENCH_MODULE_PROGRAM_KEYS:-linear_batched,lazy_matmul_add_gelu_batched,lazy_rms_silu_ffn_batched} node scripts/check_module_program_bench.cjs
scripts.dev:perf:pytorch:focus: zig build ffi-c -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -fincremental --summary failures && npm run build:package && BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS=${BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS:-linear_batched,lazy_rms_silu_ffn_batched,rms_gelu_linear_batched,log_softmax_classifier_batched,lazy_token_head_batched} node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.dev:perf:pytorch:gaps: zig build ffi-c -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -fincremental --summary failures && npm run build:package && BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS=${BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS:-linear_batched,log_softmax_classifier_batched} node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.dev:perf:q8-prompt: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build -fincremental --summary failures && BENCH_BUILD_ZGML=0 node scripts/check_q8_prompt_candidate.cjs
scripts.dev:perf:ggml:smoke: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build -fincremental --summary failures && BENCH_BUILD_ZGML=0 BENCH_ALLOW_QUARANTINED=1 BENCH_ZGML_SAMPLES=${BENCH_ZGML_SAMPLES:-1} ./scripts/bench_vs_ggml.sh ${BENCH_GGML_PROMPT:-128} ${BENCH_GGML_GEN:-40} ${BENCH_GGML_REPS:-1}
scripts.dev:perf:ggml:q8-command-smoke: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build -fincremental --summary failures && BENCH_BUILD_ZGML=0 BENCH_ALLOW_QUARANTINED=1 BENCH_ZGML_SAMPLES=${BENCH_ZGML_SAMPLES:-1} ZGML_Q8_EXTRA_ARGS="--metal-prompt-projection-row-chain-command" ./scripts/bench_vs_ggml.sh ${BENCH_GGML_PROMPT:-128} ${BENCH_GGML_GEN:-40} ${BENCH_GGML_REPS:-1}
scripts.check:ts-source-architecture: node scripts/check_ts_source_architecture.cjs && npm run check:native-runtime-wrappers && npm run check:native-substrate-manifest && npm run check:package-metadata
scripts.smoke:portable-ffi: npm run build:package && zig build ffi-c-smoke ffi-node-smoke ffi-bun-smoke ffi-wasm-smoke
scripts.smoke:training: npm run build:package && node examples/node_training/train_linear.cjs && node examples/node_training/manual_loop.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_mlp.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_classifier.cjs && node examples/node_training/torch_quickstart.cjs
scripts.smoke:training:bun: npm run build:package && bun examples/bun_training/train_linear.ts && bun examples/bun_training/manual_loop.ts && bun examples/bun_training/train_mlp.ts && bun examples/bun_training/train_classifier.ts
scripts.test:ts-source: npm run build:ts-source && npm run check:ts-source-architecture && npm run build:package && npm run smoke:ts-source && npm run check:package-artifact && npm run typecheck:dist && npm run smoke:dist && npm run smoke:frontend
scripts.smoke: node dist/smokes/node_package_smoke.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_linear.cjs && node examples/node_training/manual_loop.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_mlp.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_classifier.cjs && node examples/node_training/torch_quickstart.cjs && node examples/node_program_session/run_linear.cjs
scripts.smoke:node: node dist/smokes/node_package_smoke.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_linear.cjs && node examples/node_training/manual_loop.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_mlp.cjs && node examples/node_training/train_classifier.cjs && node examples/node_training/torch_quickstart.cjs && node examples/node_program_session/run_linear.cjs
scripts.smoke:bun: npm run build:package && npm run smoke:bun:dist
scripts.smoke:bun:dist: bun ./dist/smokes/bun_package_smoke.cjs && bun examples/bun_training/train_linear.ts && bun examples/bun_training/manual_loop.ts && bun examples/bun_training/train_mlp.ts && bun examples/bun_training/train_classifier.ts && bun examples/bun_program_session/run_linear.ts && mkdir -p .zig-cache && bun build ./dist/bun_native.cjs --target=bun --outfile=.zig-cache/zgml-bun-adapter-check.js
scripts.smoke:adapters: npm run build:package && npm run smoke:node && npm run smoke:bun:dist
scripts.bench:frontier:qproj: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build && BENCH_FRONTIER_BUILD=0 BENCH_FRONTIER_FILTER=qproj node scripts/check_frontier_bench.cjs
scripts.bench:frontier:gate: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build && BENCH_FRONTIER_BUILD=0 node scripts/check_frontier_bench.cjs
scripts.bench:stencil:shape: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build && BENCH_STENCIL_BUILD=0 node scripts/check_stencil_shape.cjs
scripts.bench:q8-prompt-candidate: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast bench-build && BENCH_BUILD_ZGML=0 node scripts/check_q8_prompt_candidate.cjs
scripts.bench:module-program:focus: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:package && BENCH_MODULE_PROGRAM_KEYS=${BENCH_MODULE_PROGRAM_KEYS:-linear_batched,lazy_matmul_add_gelu_batched,lazy_rms_silu_ffn_batched} node scripts/check_module_program_bench.cjs
scripts.bench:pytorch: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:package && node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.bench:pytorch:parity: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:package && BENCH_PYTORCH_REQUIRE_PARITY=1 BENCH_PYTORCH_INSTALL=1 node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.bench:pytorch:parity:run: npm run build:native:release && BENCH_PYTORCH_REQUIRE_PARITY=1 BENCH_PYTORCH_ATTEMPTS=${BENCH_PYTORCH_ATTEMPTS:-3} node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.bench:pytorch:focus: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:package && BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS=${BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS:-linear_batched,lazy_rms_silu_ffn_batched,rms_gelu_linear_batched,log_softmax_classifier_batched,lazy_token_head_batched} node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.bench:pytorch:gaps: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:package && BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS=${BENCH_PYTORCH_KEYS:-linear_batched,log_softmax_classifier_batched} node scripts/check_pytorch_comparison.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:adapters
scripts.test:adapters: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:adapters
scripts.test:repo: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts-source && npm run smoke:native-contract && npm run smoke:portable-ffi && npm run smoke:portable-ffi:browser && npm run smoke:training && npm run smoke:adapters && npm run check:packed-install && npm run check:goal-scorecard
